KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. zito
   B. nene
   C. fupi
   D. pana

2. When practising Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mazungumzo, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. Avoid reading anything related to Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mazungumzo.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mazungumzo.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mazungumzo.

3. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   D. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
